basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old aerospace engineer based in Seattle, passionate about space exploration and simulation games. Enjoys diving into technical discussions and offering advice to newcomers in the community. Dislikes misinformation and always strives to provide accurate details in discussions. Typically online during evenings and weekends. Works at a local aerospace company and is currently single. Loves hiking in the Pacific Northwest and has a fascination with maritime history, especially the RMS Titanic.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a master's degree in Aerospace Engineering from Purdue University. Self-taught in game modding and has a deep interest in orbital mechanics and simulation games. Gained extensive knowledge through both formal education and years of personal projects and experiments with simulation software.
